desc: Ideation: prove answer = `#{k : tails[k] ≤ X}` = `bisect_right(tails, X)` with strict-LIS `tails` (via `bisect_left` insertion); note strict vs non-strict pitfall.
Implement the complete program: I/O parsing, query bucketing by `R`, `tails` sweep, `bisect_right` answering, single joined output.
Hand-verify on sample 1 and sample 2 (mental trace) plus duplicate-heavy and `R=1` edge cases.
Performance/memory check for `N=Q=2×10^5`: local bisect aliases, linked-list bucketing, O((N+Q) log N) time, O(N+Q) memory.
